descriptionChirho: A Hebrew proper name (אֲחִינֹעַם, 'my brother is delight/pleasantness') referring to two women: (1) Ahinoam of Jezreel, one of David's wives (1 Sam 25:43; 27:3; 30:5; 2 Sam 2:2; 3:2), and (2) Ahinoam daughter of Ahimaaz, wife of King Saul (1 Sam 14:50). All three sense clusters are purely grammatical variants — bare nominative and with prepositions (to/from Ahinoam). Multilingual renderings are uniform: spa 'Ajinoam', arb 'أَخِينُوعَم', hin 'अहीनोअम', kor '아히노암', swa 'Ahinoamu'.
